name: PEIWAY Realtime Google Sheets Upsert Template

nodes.name: 接收系統即時同步 Webhook

parameters.jsCode:
const source = $input.first().json;
const row = source.content_params.record || {};
return [{ json: {
  unique_key: source.content_params.unique_key,
  id: row.id || source.content_params.unique_key,
  store_id: row.store_id || row.shop_id || source.store_id || '',
  quotation_id: row.quotation_id || '',
  payment_no: row.payment_no || '',
  pay_amount: row.pay_amount || row.amount || 0,
  pay_time: row.pay_time || row.paid_at || row.created_at || source.sent_at || '',
  pay_method: row.pay_method || row.pay_type || '',
  pay_type: row.payment_type || row.pay_type || '',
  check_status: row.check_status || '',
  remark: row.note || row.remark || '',
  created_at: row.created_at || source.sent_at || '',
  updated_at: row.updated_at || source.sent_at || ''
}}];

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { ok: true, status: 'accepted', sync_type: $json.content_params?.sync_type || $json.sync_type, unique_key: $json.content_params?.unique_key || $json.unique_key, n8n_execution_id: $execution.id } }}
={{ { ok: false, status: 'failed', error: 'invalid security key', n8n_execution_id: $execution.id } }}
